P2para.Text: In these Regulations, unless the context otherwise requires—

Para.Text: "concession owner" means, in relation to a well, a person who has the right to exploit or explore mineral resources or to store gas in a controlled reservoir in the area in which the well is or is to be situated;
"duty holder" means, in relation to a fixed installation, the operator of that installation and, in relation to a mobile installation, the owner of that installation;
properties and configuration of the sea-bed and sub-sea;
"executive" means the Health and Safety Executive;
"external waters" means the territorial sea adjacent to Great Britain and any area designated by order under section 1(7) of the Continental Shelf Act 1964;
"installation" means an offshore installation within the meaning of regulation 3;
"integrity" means, in relation to an installation, the structural and load bearing capability of that installation;
"well" means a well made by drilling or any borehole or shaft, as the case may be, and includes—
any device for confining the pressure in a well; and
any equipment or materials associated with, or ancillary to, any such well;
